title: Syndicate Wars / Ghost in the shell inspired - UPDATE #01 - Persuadatron
author: KingQuiet880
selftext:
I made last video as just a mockup to see how much can be done with Codex/Meshy but since I got so many positive reactions I decided to go further and integrate some of the suggestions and what would be natural flow in-game:  
1. Persuadertron mechanics  
2. Gauss sniper rifle  
  
Also improved HUD, a lot of other weapons, explosions, driving physics etc. (but I will save it for another video). I was even working on Metal Gear meets Crusader no remorse mechanics for indoors but I need to save something for another video. 

Here is the link to the last one: [The Start](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1wxqhqw/comment/pf8i6t2/?screen_view_count=2)
